Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:91492: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: netfilter: nfnetlink_queue: acquire rcu_read_lock() in instance_destroy_rcu() (CVE-2024-36286)

* kernel: xfrm: Duplicate SPI Handling (CVE-2025-39797)

* kernel: Linux kernel: Denial of Service in qla2xxx SCSI driver due to improper command handling after chip reset (CVE-2025-68745)

* kernel: ALSA: 6fire: fix use-after-free on disconnect (CVE-2026-31581)

* kernel: Bluetooth: MGMT: validate LTK enc_size on load (CVE-2026-43020)

* kernel: netfilter: nfnetlink_cthelper: fix OOB read in nfnl_cthelper_dump_table() (CVE-2026-43450)

* kernel: Linux kernel: xfrm single-frag length not properly limited ()

* kernel: scsi: target: configfs: Bound snprintf() return in tg_pt_gp_members_show() (CVE-2026-46149)

* kernel: crypto: af_alg - Cap AEAD AD length to 0x80000000 (CVE-2026-52972)

* kernel: mac802154: llsec: add skb_cow_data() before in-place crypto (CVE-2026-63831)

* kernel: blk-cgroup: fix UAF in __blkcg_rstat_flush() (CVE-2026-63802)

* kernel: vxlan: do not reuse cached ip_hdr() value after skb_tunnel_check_pmtu() (CVE-2026-63993)

* kernel: nvmet: fix pre-auth out-of-bounds heap read in Discovery Get Log Page (CVE-2026-64320)

* kernel: nvmet-auth: validate reply message payload bounds against transfer length (CVE-2026-64319)

* kernel: ALSA: virtio: Validate control metadata from the device (CVE-2026-64490)

* kernel: mm/khugepaged: write all dirty file folios when collapsing (CVE-2026-68086)

* kernel: Linux kernel: ALSA timer use-after-free vulnerability allows privilege escalation (CVE-2026-68200)

* kernel: nvmet-auth: reject short AUTH_RECEIVE buffers (CVE-2026-72130)

* kernel: selinux: check connect-related permissions on TCP Fast Open (CVE-2026-72243)

* kernel: scsi: libiscsi_tcp: Bound SCSI Response data segment to the connection buffer (CVE-2026-74556)

* kernel: ALSA: usx2y: bound the hwdep mmap fault offset (CVE-2026-74641)

* kernel: crypto: tegra - fix rctx->cryptlen calculation in tegra_gcm_do_one_req() (CVE-2026-80522)

* kernel: scsi: qla2xxx: Bound rsp_info_len to avoid OOB sense-data read (CVE-2026-89846)

* kernel: kernel: strparser: use-after-free via msg_timer_work rearm after strp_done() cancellation ()

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* kernel panics caused by NULL pointer dereferences within octeon_ep_vf [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-186330)

* Customer needs "netfilter: nfnetlink_queue: optimize verdict lookup with hash table" patch [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-224488)

* Kernel panic reboot node with kernal version 5.14.0-427.68.1.el9_4 (JIRA:RHEL-260120)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
